document_title: How to create workflows for business spaces
content:
Control assignees for specific statuses
You can make it so that whenever a status of a work item is changed, it forces the user to choose a new assignee. This ensures that the next part of the work gets done by the right person. See advanced workflow configuration for more.
Manage transition properties
Business spaces recognize some properties on transitions. The most common one is to limit resolutions displayed to the user on a given transition. For example, we might want the resolution scratched to show up for disk media when retiring, but not for books.
For more information about these tasks, see Advanced workflow configuration.
Get the most out of your workflows
- Before you edit a workflow, make sure it isn't being used by any other spaces! Any changes made to a shared workflow will impact all the spaces using it.
- To re-use a workflow in another space, select Create with shared configuration when you create the new space or update the default workflow in the new space to the one that you want.
- Remember to hit Publish to make new or edited workflows active in your space.
